sanskrit: jagadvandya śūlapāṇe varṇānāṃ kāraṇaṃ vadana prakāśyaṃ mahādevi ! tava snehāt subhāṣiṇitacchṛṇuśva svarūpeṇa mahāyauvanagarvitevidyudjihvā karālāsyā garjinī dhūmrabhairavīsaṃhāriṇī karālinī ūrdhvakeśyugrabhairavīete varṇāṇ svarā jñeyāḥ kaulini vyaṃjanān śṛṇujvālāmukho raktadaṃṣṭro hasitāṅgo vaḍavāmukhaḥsaṃhārī bhairavo daṇḍī valibhugugraśūladhṛkbahurūpī mahākālo jīvātmā kṣatajokṣitaḥvṛṣadhvajo vyomavaktrastrailokyagrasanātmakaḥakārādikṣakārāntā varṇāstu śivaśaktayaḥyeṣāṃ jñānaṃ vinā vāme siddhirna syād gurustanividyudjihvā mukhaṃ kṛtvā caṇḍikāntaṃ nagātmajekrodhīśād daṇḍiparyantā vyañjanā rājasāḥ smṛtāḥjñeyāstamaḥsvarūpāste tebhyo jātān śṛṇu priyeandhakāranirodhitvād gururityabhidhīyateukārastu bhaved viṣṇustritayātmā guruḥ svayamvasujihvā kālarātryā rudraḍākinyalaṅkṛtāoṃ caṇḍīśaḥ kṣatajārūḍho dhūmrabhairavyalaṅkṛtaḥśrīṃ | krodhīśaṃ kṣatajārūḍhaṃ dhūmrabhairavyalaṅkṛtamdhrīṃ (krodhīśovalabhṛd)(valibhug) dhūmrabhairavīnādabindubhiḥkrī/ | kṣatajastho vyomavaktro thūmrabhairavyalaṅkṛtaḥkrīṃ | vyomāsyañja vidārīsthaṃ nādabinduvirājitamhū/ | vyomāsyaḥ kālarātryāḍhyo varmabid bindusaṃyutaḥdū/ | vyomāsyaṃ kṣatajārūḍhaṃ ḍākinyā nādabindubhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00026 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: drā/ | nādabindusamāyuktāṃ samādāyograbhairavīmaiṃ pralayāgnirmahājālaḥ khyāto'stramanuḥ śivekrau/ | dviṭhaḥ śivo vahni jāyā svāhā jvalanavallabhānādabindusamāyuktaṃ kiṅkiṇībījamuttamamkarālāsyāsanopetaṃ viśikākhyaṃ mahāmanumnādabindusamāyukto vijñeyaḥ piśitāśanaḥyugāntakārakaṃ bījaṃ vīrapatniprakāśitamnādabindusamāyuktaṃ bījaṃ baitālikaṃ smṛtamkampinībījamityuktaṃ caṇḍikākhyaṃ manoharamsaṃyuktaṃ dhūmrabhairavyā dhvāṅkṣo'yaṃ nādabindumānsanādastu namityuktaṃ caṇḍikākhyaṃ payodharamsaṃyukto dhūmrabhairavyā smṛtā phetkāriṇī priyekhadyotamiti vikhyātaṃ grasinīkālarātriyukvidārībhūṣitaṃ devi bījaṃ vaivasvatātmakamprathamaḥ paṭalaḥetadeva mahādeva kathyatāṃ me pinākadhṛkatiguhyaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ tattvatrayaṃ varānaneśaṅkāpi jāyate devi kathaṃ tatkathayāmyahamna cet tat kathyate devi tava krodhaḥ prajāyatemantrārthaṃ mantracaitanyaṃ dharmārthakāmadaṃ priyeajñātvā yo japenmantraṃ nahi siddhiḥ prajāyateyonimudrā maheśāni sākṣānmokṣaprasādhinīsatataṃ parameśāni dāso'haṃ tava yonināmṛtyujjayo'haṃ deveśi satataṃ kamalānanetiṣṭhanti satataṃ devi brahmādyāstridivaukasaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00026 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yonyākāraṃ maheśāni dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaḥ śucismitetava yoniṃ maheśāni bhāvayāmītyaharnniśamkarpūrapulakodbhūtaṃ tava yonipuraṃ paramretorajaḥsamāyuktaṃ sākṣānmanmathamandiramtava yonau mahādevi ata eva varānaneahaṃ mṛtyujjayo devi yonimudrāprasādataḥprathame parameśāni yoginīṃ rudrayoginīmvindvardhacandrasaṃyuktaṃ bījaṃ trailokyamohanamyonibījaṃ maheśāni aṣṭottaraśataṃ japetmāhātmyaṃ tasya deveśi vaktuṃ ko vā kṣamo bhavetbrahmāṇḍaṃ pūjayet te na brahmādyāstridivaukasaḥtava yonirmaheśāni bhavasya mohinī priyesiddhisūtraṃ maheśāni triprakāraṃ varānanesadānandamayīṃ yoniṃ nānāsukhavilāsinīmmama liṅgo maheśāni bhinatti sakalaṃ jagattava yonirmaheśāni na jāne kīdṛśīṃ gatimsadā kuṇḍalinīṃ yonimahākuṇḍalinīṃ parāmjaped bījaṃ varārohe bhagāravyaṃ bhagarūpiṇīmaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā mama tulyo bhavet priyesa eva dhanavān vāgmī vāgīśasamatāṃ vrajetyadi no kathyate deva vimuñcāmi tadā tanumgopanīyaṃ rahasyaṃ hi sarvakāmaphalapradamtāsu madhye daśa proktāstāsu tisro vyavasthitāḥmajjayitvā suṣumnāyāmahaṃ yogī sureśvariprathamaṃ parameśāni ādhārayugapatrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00026 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taḍitkoṭiprabhākāraṃ sthānaṃ paramadurlabhamicchājñānakriyārūpaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakamtrikoṇākhyaṃ tu deveśi lakāraṃ cintayet tathābījaṃ tatraiva niścintyaṃ yonāvādānameva caghrāṇaṃ saṃcintya deveśi maheśi prāṇavallabheetāni girije mātaḥ pṛthvīṃ nītvā gaṇeśvaritatra kuṇḍalinīṃ nityāṃ paramānandarūṣiṇīmkoṭicandraprabhākārāṃ paraṃbrahmasvarūpiṇīmtathā ca pustakaṃ vīṇāṃ dhāriṇīṃ siṃhavāhinīmpūrvoktāṃ pṛthvīṃ dhanyāṃ gandhe nītvā maheśvarikuṇḍalinyā saha preme gandhamādāya sādhakaḥtatpadmaṃ liṅgamūlasthaṃ sindūrābhaṃ ca ṣaḍdalamtatkarṇikāyāṃ varuṇaṃ tatrāpi bhāvayeddharimrasanendriyayūpasthaṃ jalañca kāmalālasejīvātmānaṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ rasañca maṇipūrakenīlavarṇaṃ taḍidrūpaṃ ḍādiphāntaiśca maṇḍitamtatra rudraḥ svayaṃ kartā saṃhāre sakalasya catatra cakṣurindriyañca kṛtvā tejomayaṃ yajetjīvātmānaṃ kuṇḍalinīrūpañcānāhate nayetkādiṭhāntaiḥ sphuradvarṇaiḥ śobhitāṃ haravallabhāmtatra yonermaṇḍalañca bāṇaliṅgavirājitametad rūpañca saṃyojya svarge ramaṇakāminidhūmravarṇaṃ kaṇṭhapadmaṃ ṣoḍaśasvaramaṇḍitamvācaṃ śrotraṃ ca ākāśe saṃsthāpya naganandinijīrva kuṇḍalinīṃ śabdañcājñāpatre nidhāpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00026 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatkarṇikāyāṃ trikoṇaṃ yad bāṇaliṅgañca saṅgatambuddhiprakṛtyahaṅkāralakṣitaṃ tejasā paramsahasrāre mahāpadme manaścāpi niyojayetakārādikṣakārāntaiḥ sphuradvarṇairvirājitamsūryasya maṇḍalañcaiva candramaṇḍalameva catasmin randhre visargañca nityānandaṃ nirañjatamtasyādhaḥsthā ca deveśi caturmaṇḍalamadhyagamiha sthāne mahādevi sthiracittaṃ vidhāya caatra nityoditā vṛddhikṣayahīnā amākalānirvāṇākhyāntargatā vahnirūpā nirodhikānirvāṇaśaktiḥ paramā sarveṣāṃ yonirūpiṇīatraiva kuṇḍalīśakti rmudrākārā sureśvarikathitā yonimudreyaṃ mayā te parameśvaritad divyāmṛtadhārābhirlākṣābhābhirmaheśvarikuṇḍalīśaktisiddhiḥ syād varṇakoṭiśatairapimantrarūpāṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ dhyātvā ṣaṭcakramaṇḍalegacchantīṃ brahmarandhreṇa praviśantīṃ svaketanamcitriṇīgrathitā mālājāpaṃ brahmāṇḍasundarimudrācaitanyayorjñānaṃ varṇānāṃ jñānameva caiti te kathitaṃ devi yonikrīḍedamuttamamidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi yoneḥ kavacamuttamametasya kavacasyāpi ṛṣiśca śrīsadāśivaḥcaturvargeṣu deveśi viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥajñātvā yo japenmantraṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalatāṃ vrajetmūlādhāre maheśāni japed yantraṃ varānane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00026 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praticakre maheśāni paṭhed yoniṃ sanātanīmsvanārīṃ ramayed yantre paranārīmathāpi vāidaṃ hi kavacaṃ devi paṭhitvā kamalānanekavacasya prasādena janā yānti parāṃ gatimśuklena kusumenāpi rocanālaktakena caiha loke paratre ca sa eva śrīsadāśivaḥnamo yonyai namo yonyai kuṇḍalinyai namo namaḥiti dakṣiṇāmnāye sārdhalakṣagranthe kaṅkālamālinītantre yonimudrādikathanaṃ dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥnirguṇañca paraṃ brahma gururityakṣaradvayamtatra dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu pārvati sādaramtasyopari nādabindormadhye siṃhāsanojjvalevīrāsanasamāsīnaṃ mudrābharaṇabhūṣitamvāmoruśaktisahitaṃ kāruṇyenāvalokitamvāmenotpaladhāriṇyā raktābharaṇabhūṣayāmānasaistūpacāraiśca saṃpūjya kalpayet sudhīḥdhūpaṃ vāyvātmakaṃ devi tejasā dīpameva caambaraṃ mukuṭaṃ dadyāt vastrañcaiva mama priyetattanmudrāvidhānena saṃpūjyātha guruṃ yajetiti te kathitaṃ samyag gurupūjanamuttamambhūtanātha mahādeva kavacaṃ tasya me vadayasya jñānaṃ vinā devi na siddhirna ca sadgatiḥasya prasādāt sakalā vedāgamapuraḥsarāḥchando virāḍ devatā ca gurudevaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥsahasrāre mahāpadme karpūradhavalo guruḥparamākhyo guruḥ pātu śirasaṃ ma vallabhe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00026 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kaṇṭhaṃ mama sadā pātu prahlādānandanāthakaḥvaśiṣṭhanandanāthaśca hṛdayaṃ pātu sarvadādhyānānandaśca sarvāṅgaṃ bodhānandaśca kānaneiti te kathitaṃ bhadre kavacaṃ paramaṃ śiveasyaiva paṭhanād devi dhāraṇācchravaṇāt priyekaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau śikhāyāṃ vīravanditeidaṃ kavacamajñātvā yadi mantraṃ japet priyeśive ruṣṭe gurustrātā gurau ruṣṭe na kaścanalokeśa kathyatām deva gurugītā mayi prabhoguruḥ svayaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāmahameva prakāśakaḥgayā gaṅgā kāśikā ca tvameva sakalaṃ jagatcandrabhāgā gautamī ca tvameva kulapālikānahi te vaktumarhāmi kriyājālaṃ maheśvarikathaṃ tvaṃ jananī bhūtvā badhūstvaṃ mama dehināmiti te kathitā gītā gurudevasya brahmaṇaḥjagat samastamastheyaṃ gurustheyo hi kevalamnānāvidhadravyadānaiḥ siddhiḥ syāt sādhakottamaḥiti śrīdakṣiṇāmnāye sārdhalakṣagranthe kaṅkālamālinītantre śrīgurupūjanakavacagurugītā nāma tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥyasya vijñānamātreṇa sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetśaucena śucinā tulyo balena pavanopamaḥsārvajñe śambhunā tulyo dāne dādhīcinā samaḥbhṛgoriva tapasvī ca candravat prītivardhanaḥrūpeṇa madanaḥ sākṣāt pratāpe bhānusannibhaḥsiddhānāṃ bhairavaḥ sākṣāt gaṅgeva malanāśakaḥna tasya dūritaṃ kiñcit mahākālīṃ smareddhiyā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00026 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhogena mokṣamāpnoti śrutvā gurumukhāt parāmkrodhīśaṃ kṣatajārūḍhaṃ dhūmrabhairavyalakṣitamekākṣarīsamā nāsti vidyā tribhuvane priyeathānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi dakṣiṇāṃ kālikāṃ parāmmāyābījaṃ tato bhadre tryakṣaraṃ mantramīritamaparaṃ tryakṣaraṃ proktaṃ pūrvoktaṃ phaladaṃ priyeetattu tryakṣaraṃ devi sarvakāmaphalapradamna kālaniyamo'trāsti nārimitrādidūṣaṇamdivā vā yadi vā rātrau japaḥ sarvatra śobhanaḥbhogena labhate mokṣaṃ naro'pi vidyayānayānānayā sadṛśī vidyā nānayā sadṛśo japaḥsatyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ satyapūrvaṃ vadāmyahamatha saṃkṣepato vakṣye pūjāvidhimanuttamampūjā ca trividhā proktā nityanaimittikāmyataḥbhairavo'sya ṛṣiḥ prokta uṣṇik chanda udāhṛtamviniyogastu vidyāyāḥ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayepañcaśuddhiṃ vinā pūjā abhicārāya kalpyatemantraśuddhirdevaśuddhiḥ pañcaśuddhiritīritāāsanaṃ kalpayedādau komalaṃ kambalantu vābhūtaśuddhiṃ tathā kuryāt pūjāyogyā yathā bhavetādau śuddhibhairavāya ṛṣaye nama ityathamama priye mahākālī devatāyai namo hṛdikavitvārthe viniyoga iti vinyasya vāñchayāoṃ krā/ aṅguṣṭhayornyasya oṃ krī/ tarjanyornamaḥoṃ krau/ kaniṣṭhāyugale oṃ kraḥ karatale tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00026 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaḍadīrghabhāvaṃ svabījaiḥ praṇavādyaistu vinyaseta ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ ca hṛdaye nyasetṅa ca cha ja jha ña ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha vai vāmake bhujema ya ra la va śa ṣa sa ha la kṣa vāmajaṅghakeśira-ādi ca pādāntaṃ nyased vyāpakamuttamatha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi bhairavākāradāyakamdivyasthāne mahāpīṭhe maṇimaṇḍaparājitetatra dhyāyenmahākālīmādyāṃ bhairavanditāmvande cañcalacandrakāntamaṇibhirmālāṃ dadhānāṃ parāmtatra pīṭhe mahādevīṃ kālīṃ dānavasevitāmdānābhītivimuktakeśanicayā dhyeyā sadā kālikākālīṃ karālavadanāṃ ghoradaṃṣṭrāṃ trilocanāmvīrāsanasamāsīnāṃ mahākālopari sthitāmmuṇḍamālāgaladraktacarcitāṃ pīvarastanīmvāme khaḍgaṃ chinnamuṇḍaṃ dhāriṇīṃ dakṣiṇe kareśakuntapakṣasaṃyuktavāṇakarṇavibhūṣitāmcaṇḍahāsacaṇḍanādacaṇḍākhyānaiśca bhairavaiḥsevitākhilasiddhaughairmunibhiḥ sevitāṃ parāmmānasairupacāraiśca so'hamātmānamarcayetdaśapañcārapadmeṣu pīṭhapūjāṃ samācarettato dhyāyenmahādevīṃ kālikāṃ kulabhūṣaṇāmkālīṃ kapālinīṃ kullāṃ kurukullāṃ virodhinīmugrāmugraprabhāṃ dīptāṃ tatra trikoṇake punaḥkālīṃ kṛpālinī kullāṃ kurukullāṃ virodhinīmugrāmugreprabhāṃ dīptāṃ tatra trikoṇake punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00026 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mātrāṃ mudrāṃ nityāñcaiva tathaivāntastrikoṇaketarjanīṃ vāmahastena dhārayantī śucismitābrāhmī nārāyaṇī caiva tathaiva ca maheśvarīvārāhī ca tathā pūjyā nārasiṃhī tathaiva caanulepanakaṃ gandhaṃ dhūpadīpau ca pānakampunargandhādibhiḥ pūjya japtvā śeṣaṃ samarpayetmadhu māṃsaṃ tathā matsyaṃ yat kiñca kulasādhanamtadanujñāṃ mūrdhni kṛtvā śeṣaṃ cātmani yojayetjanmāntarasahasrasya sukṛtistasya naśyatimadhunā na vinā mantraṃ na mantreṇa vinā madhukuṇḍakumbhakapālādipadārthānāṃ niṣevaṇambrahmāṇḍakhaṇḍasambhūtamaśeṣaratnasambhavamathavā kumbhamadhye'smin sravantaṃ paramāmṛtamtad vāhyaṃ sphāṭikodāramaṇicandraṃ ca maṇḍalamārambhastaruṇaḥ prauḍhastadante taruṇaḥ punaḥsarvaśeṣe ca deveśi sāmānyārghyaṃ pade'rpayetsāṅgakriyāṃ pade datvā sāmānyārghyaṃ śive bhavetbhogena labhate mokṣaṃ bahunā jalpitena kimyadvā tadvā yena kena sarvadā sarvato'pi cabālāṃ vā yauvanonmattāṃ vṛddhāṃ vā yuvatīṃ tathātāsāṃ prahāro nindā ca kauṭilyamapriyaṃ tathānityapūjākramaṃ bhaktyā jñātvā siddhimavāpnuyātiti dakṣiṇāmnāye kaṅkālamālinītantre sārdhalakṣagranthe mahākālīmantrapūjākathanaṃ nāma caturthaḥ paṭalaḥkasmin kāle ca kartavyaṃ kalau siddhidamadbhutamnāśubho vidyate kālo nāśubho vidyate kvacit
source_edition: Muktabodha M00026 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kālākālaṃ maheśāni bhrāntimātraṃ na saṃśayaḥtatkāle ca mahābhīme ko gacchati śubhāśubhamanirdiṣṭāyuṣaḥ sarve kālacintā kathaṃ priyepuraścaryāvidhau devi kālacintāṃ na cācaretdikkālaniyamo nātra sthityādiniyamo nahisvecchācāro'tra niyamo mahāmantrasya sādhanejambūdvīpe ca varṣe ca kalau bhāratasaṃjñakeyannoktaṃ sarvatantreṣu tadadya kathayāmi tekalau ca bhārate varṣe yena siddhiḥ prajāyatekalikāle varārohe japamātraṃ praśasyatepuraścaryāṃ vinā devi kalau mantraṃ na sādhayetkalikāle durāgharṣaṃ sarvaduḥkhamayaṃ sadāprātaḥkṛtyādikaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ snānaṃ samācaretpūjāṃ caiva varārohe yasya yat paṭalakramātprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caiva māṣabhaktabaliṃ tathāādau gaṇapaterbījaṃ gamityekākṣaraṃ viduḥoṃ gaṃ gaṇapataye svāhā iti mantreṇa sādhakaḥoṃ bhairavāya tataḥ svāhā bhairavāya baliṃ tataḥoṃ yāṃ yoginibhyo namaḥ svāhā ca yoginībalimkathopakathanaṃ devi tyajedatra surālayepaścime kṣetrapālāya yoginyai dakṣiṇe dadettadā siddhimavāpnoti cānyathā hāsyakevalamarddhatolaṃ ghṛtañcaiva dadhi arddhārddhatolakameteṣāṃ sahayogena balirbhavati śāmbhavicandrabindumayaṃ bījaṃ kūmabījaṃ itīritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00026 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūtaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ paramyaḥ kuryānmātṛkānyāsaṃ sa śivo nātra saṃśayaḥrudrākṣasya ca māhātmyaṃ bhasmanaśca śṛṇu priyeśodhayenmūlamantreṇa aṣṭottaraśataṃ japanbāhvoḥ pārśvadvaye devi kaṇṭhadeśe hṛdi priyekūrparād bāhuparyantaṃ kakṣe grīvāsu pārvatimadhyamānāmikāṅgulyaṅguṣṭhena tilakaṃ tataḥpṛthivyagnistathā śaktiḥ kriyāśaktirmaheśvaraḥna bhasmāṃścaiva subhage dvitīyā caiva devatāetānnityaṃ namaskṛtya tripuṇḍraṃ dhārayed yadibrahmacārī gṛhastho vā vanastho vā yatistathātathā'nyakṣatraviṭśūdrastrīhatyādiṣu pātakaiḥamantreṇāpi yaḥ kuryād jñātvā ca mahimonnatimparadravyāpaharaṇaṃ paradārābhimarṣaṇamasatyavākyapaiśunyaṃ pāruṣyaṃ devavikrayamgomṛgāṇāṃ hiraṇyasya tilakambalavāsasāmdāsīveśyāsu kṛṣṇāsu vṛṣalīsu nadīṣu camāṃsacarmarasādīnāṃ lavaṇasya ca vikrayamsadya eva vinaśyanti tridaṇḍasya ca dhāraṇātnindāyāḥ śivabhaktānāṃ prāyaścittairna śudhyatidevadravyāpaharaṇe brahmasvaharaṇena camahādevi mahābhāge brāhmaṇātikrameṇa carudrākṣaṃ yasya deheṣu lalāṭeṣu tripuṇḍrakamyāni tīrthāni loke'smin gaṅgādyāḥ saritaśca yāḥsaptakoṭimahāmantrā upamantrāstathaiva ca

sanskrit: te sarve tena japtā ca yo bibharti tripuṇḍrakamsvavaṃśajātamartyānāmuddhared yastripuṇḍrakṛtdivyaṃ vimānamāruhya divyāstraśatasevitaḥindrādilokapālānāṃ lokeṣu ca yathākramambrahmaṇaḥ padamāsādya tatra kalpāyutaṃ vasetśivalokaṃ tataḥ prāpya ramate kālamakṣayamśaive viṣṇau ca saure ca gāṇapatyeṣu pārvatibhasma teṣu maheśāni viśiṣṭaṃ parikīrtitamśaktau praśastamokṣaṃ hi bhasma yauvanajīvanesāmānyametat suśroṇi viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu matpriyehaumabhasmāt koṭiguṇaṃ viṣṇuhomaṃ maheśvarisvīyeṣṭadevatāhomamanantaṃ priyavādinina samartho yogamārgo kimanyat kathayāmi tebhāratākhye mahākāli daśāṃśaṃ kramataḥ śivelakṣaṃ vāpyayutaṃ vāpi sahasraṃ vā varānanenityahomaṃ ca kartavyaṃ śaktyā ca parameśvariaṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi aṣṭapañcāśataṃ caretaṣṭādaśaṃ dvādaśaṃ ca daśāṣṭau ca vidhānataḥevaṃ sarvatra deveśi nityakarmamahotsavaḥmālāñcaiva maheśāni narāsthyadbhutapūjitāmrudrākṣamālyaṃ saṃdhāryaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu mama priyesubhage śṛṇu suśroṇi rudrākṣaṃ paramaṃ padamabhukto vā'pi bhukto vā nīcānnīcataro'pi vārudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ puṇyaṃ kaivalyasadṛśaṃ bhavetsahasraṃ dhārayed yastu rudrākṣāṇāṃ śicismite

sanskrit: abhāve tu sahasrasya bāhvoḥ ṣoḍaśa ṣoḍaśadvātriṃśat kaṇṭhadeśe tu catvāriṃśat śire tathāyo dhārayati rudrākṣān rudravat sa ca pūjitaḥsametān dhārayed yastu rudrākṣān śiva eva saḥtaṃ na spṛśanti pāpāni timirānīva bhāskaramyasyāṅge nāsti rudrākṣa eko'pi varavarṇinirudrākṣaṃ mastake badhvā śiraḥsnānaṃ karoti yaḥrudrākṣaṃ pūjayed yastu vinā toyābhiṣecanaiḥekavaktraiḥ pañcavaktraistrayodaśamukhaistathākiṃ bahūktyā varārohe kṛtvā gatikamadbhutambhasmanā tilakaṃ kṛtvā paścād rudrākṣadhāraṇammūlamantrasiddhikāmaḥ kuryācca varṇapūjanamvilipya candanaṃ śuddhaṃ sarvavarṇātmake ghaṭeguruṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad ghaṭasthāpanamācaretpañcopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya dhyānaṃ kṛtvā prasannadhīḥkṛṣṇāmbaraparidhānāṃ śuklavastrottarīyiṇīmkaṭākṣaviśikhoddīptāmajjanāñcitalocanāmraktavidyutpratīkāśāṃ dvibhujāṃ lolalocanāmnānābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyāṃ sindūratilakojjvalāmmantrasiddhipradāṃ nityāṃ dhyāyed rajaḥsvarūpiṇīmraktavastraparīdhānāṃ kṛṣṇavastrottarīyiṇīmkaṭākṣaviśikhoddīptāṃ bhrūlatāparisevitāmdhyātvā pādyādikaṃ datvā triguṇāṃ pūjayet kramātādidhyānena subhage yajet sattvamayīṃ parāmkramāt saptadaśārṇaṃ hi dvitīyaṃ dhyānamācaran

sanskrit: kramāt saptadaśārṇaṃ hi tṛtīyaṃ dhyānamācaraniti te kathitaṃ bhadre pañcāśadvarṇapūjanamaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāṃ pūjā syād varṇapūjanātśrīviṣṇoḥ koṭimantrāśca koṭimantrāḥ śivasya caprathamaṃ praṇavaṃ datvā sahasraṃ kuṇḍalīmukhetatastu subhage mātarjapecca dīpinīṃ parāmpraṇavaṃ ca tato bhīme bhayānāṃ sahayogataḥetāmapi sahasraṃ ca prajapet kuṇḍalīmukhegāyatrīṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi a/ ṅa/ ma/ ma/ ṅa/ na/ priyeasyāśca phalamāpnoti tadaiva varavarṇinisahasrāre karṇikāyāṃ candramaṇḍalamadhyagāmunmanīnāma tasya hi bhavapāśanikṛntanībuddhimaṅkuśasaṃyuktāmunmanīṃ kusumānvitāmunmanīkusumaṃ tattu jñeyaṃ paramadurlabhamdevīṃ tāṃ gamanāgamaiḥ sthiramatirdhyāyed jaganmohinīmvinā manonmanīmantraṃ vinā dhyānaṃ japaṃ vṛthāgāyatrīmayutaṃ japtvā tadardhaṃ praṇavaṃ japetśūdrāṇāṃ praṇavaṃ devi caturdaśasvaraṃ priyemanau svāhā ca yā devī śūdroccāryā na saṃśayaḥmantro'pyūho nāsti śūdre viṣabījaṃ vinā priyetenaiva balinā bhadre haviṣyaṃ sammataṃ sadājāpakasya ca yanmantramekavarṇaṃ tataḥ priyetadā phalamavāpnoti sādhakaḥ śaktisaṅgataḥsādhakaśca haviṣyāśī sādhikā tadvivarjitānānābharaṇaveṣāḍhyā dhūpāmodanamoditā

sanskrit: gāyatrījapakāle tu sādhikā kiṃ japet prabhopūrvoktena vidhānena dhyātvā kṛtvā ca pūjanamtataḥ ṣaṣṭhadinaṃ prāpya prātaḥ snānaṃ samācaretkūrmabījaṃ likhed bhadre athavā śvetacandanaiḥevaṃ vidhāya sā sādhvī sādhako'pi prasannadhīḥlakṣaṃ japet puraścaryāvidhau vidhividhānataḥoṃ oṃ ka/ hu/ bha/ sa/ devi prātaḥ snānottara paramtataśca prajapenmantraṃ maunī madhyandināvadhisādhakaḥ śivarūpaśca sādhikā śivarūpiṇīādāvante ca praṇavaṃ datvā mantraṃ japet sudhīḥprātaḥkālaṃ samārabhya japenmadhyandināvadhidvitīyapraharādūrdhvaṃ nityapūjādikaṃ carettatpatnī śaktirūpā ca pātivratyaparāyaṇādaśadaṇḍagate rātrau śayyāyāṃ prajapenmanumvāme śrīśaktirūpā ca japecca sādhakākṣaramādyantagopanaṃ kṛtvā pratyahaṃ prajaped yadimātṛkāpuṭitaṃ kṛtvā candrabindusamanvitamjapādau subhage prauḍhe pratyahaṃ prajapenmanumsamāpte puraścaraṇe gurudevaṃ prapūjayetjambūdvīpasya varṣe ca kalikāle ca bhāratedaśāṃśaṃ kramato devi pañcāṅgavidhinā kalaubhramād yadi maheśāni kārayet sādhakottamaḥdaśāṃśaṃ jāyate pūrṇaṃ gurudevasya pūjanātdakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyāt suvarṇaṃ vāsasānvitamanyathā viphalaṃ sarvaṃ koṭipuraścareṇa kim

sanskrit: kumārī bhojitā yena trailokyaṃ tena bhojitamsarvaṃ sampūrṇamāyāti sādhako bhaktimānasaḥyasyānuṣṭhānamātreṇa mandabhāgyo'pi sidhyatimantraṃ vā sādhayiṣyāmi dehaṃ vā pātayāmyahambalidānādinā sarvaṃ mānasaiḥ paripūjya catasmin pakṣe viśeṣeṇa puraścaraṇamācaretpratyahaṃ prajapenmantraṃ sahasraṃ bhaktibhāvataḥsaptamyādau viśeṣeṇa pūjayediṣṭadevatāmaṣṭamī-navamīrātrau pūjāṃ kuryāt mahotsavamśaktyā saha varārohe kumārīpūjanaṃ caretevaṃ puraskriyāṃ kṛtvā sādhakaḥ śivatāṃ vrajetśaratkāle mahādevyā bodhena ca mahotsavepūrvoktavidhinā mantrī kuryāt puraskriyāṃ dhiyāśaratkāle caturthyādi navamyantaṃ sahasrakamtathā sarvopacāraistu vastrālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥaṣṭamīsandhivelāyāṃ tenaina vidhinā paśumvibhīrdhyānaparo bhūtvā vāṃchitāṃ siddhimāpnuyātgurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād daśamyāṃ pārayettataḥathavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyatepraviśya mantrī vidhivat tāsāmabhyarcya yatnataḥkevalaṃ kāmadevo'sau japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatamlatāgṛhaṃ śṛṇu prauḍhe kāmakautukalālaseyauvanādiguṇairyuktāḥ sādhikāḥ kāmagarvitāḥathavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyatesādhakaḥ pūrṇatāṃ prāpya sarvabhogeśvaro bhavet

sanskrit: caturdaśīṃ samārabhya yāvadanyā caturdaśīathavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyatesahasrasaṃkhyājapte tu puraścaraṇamiṣyateathavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyateaṣṭamī-navamīrātrau pūjāṃ kuryād viśeṣataḥṣaṭsahasraṃjapennityaṃ bhaktibhāvaparāyaṇaḥaṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ vīravanditetāvajjapte nirātaṅkaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetaṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapitāvajjapto nirātaṃkaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetudayāstaṃ divā japtvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetjapitvā cāstaparyantaṃ sādhakaḥ siddhimāpnuyātathavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyateṛtavaḥ syurvasantādyā ahorātraṃ dine dinevasantaścaiva pūrvāhṇe grīṣmo madhyandinaṃ tathāarddharātrau tu hemantaḥ seṣe ca śiśiraḥ smṛtaḥtāvajjapte maheśāni puraścaryā hi sidhyatigurave dakṣiṇāṃ datvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetgrīṣmādiṣu maheśāni pañcasvarttuṣu sādhakaḥpūrvoktavidhinā sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ vīravanditeevamācaryakṛtyaṃ vai dhanānāmīśvaro bhavetkumārīpūjanādeva puraścaryāvidhiḥ smṛtaḥgurumānīya saṃsthāpya devavat pūjayed vibhumtatsutaṃ tatsutaṃ vāpi tatpatnīñca viśeṣataḥgurusantoṣamātreṇa duṣṭamantro'pi sidhyati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00026 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ kramavidhānena kṛtvā nityaṃ hi sādhakaḥsādhanaiḥ subhage bhadre yadi siddhirna jāyatekhyātirvāhanabhūṣādilābhaḥ sucirajīvitāmahadaiśvaryanityañca putrapautrādisampadaḥekavarṣāntare vāpi santi śaṅkaravanditeatropāyān pravakṣyāmi yadi siddhivilambanampoṣaṇaṃ toṣaṇañcaiva dahanañca tataḥ paramdvāpare ca tathā bhadre upāyaṃ saptamaṃ smṛtamḍākinyādiyutaṃ kṛtvā lakṣañca prajapenmanumrākiṇīpuṭitaṃ kṛtvā lakṣañca prajapenmanumlākinīpuṭitaṃ kṛtvā lakṣañca prajapenmanumkākinīpuṭitaṃ kṛtvā lakṣañca prajapenmanumśākinīpuṭitaṃ kṛtvā lakṣañca prajapenmanumtadā siddho bhavenmantro nātra kāryā vicāraṇāpuṭitaṃ sattvarupiṇyā lakṣañca prajapenmanumkakārādikṣakārāntā mātṛkā varṇarūpiṇīchinnavidyādayo mantrāstantre tantre nirūpitāḥniścitaṃ mantrasiddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇātato gurupuṭīkṛtya lakṣañca saṃjapenmanumyadi no kathyate deva vimuñcāmi tadā tanumjambūdvīpasya varṣeṣu kalau lokādhamāḥ smṛtāḥduṣkriyāyāṃ ratāḥ sarve paramajñānavarjitāḥvinā śabdaparijñānaṃ mantradātā dvijo bhavetjāyate tena me śaṅkā kathaṃ me prāṇavallabhekathyataṃ kathyatāṃ deva yataste sevikā vayam
